title: Pufferpig Shenanigans
description: This project adds new funny friends and items to the game!
body:
# Pufferpig Shenanigans 🐖

## 💡 **What does this mod have to offer?**
Ever wanted a companion that can defeat almost anything with ease while still looking adorable? Now it is possible with the new pufferpig entity! That's not it this mod adds a bunch of useful items and recipes, for example the new more golden carrot and enchanted golden carrot as they give benifical effects when consumed. You can also harness the power of a pufferpig with the new anti-pufferpig-3000 that shoots anti puffer pig orbs that can oneshot almost any mob

## ✅ **Features**

### V0.5
- **Entities**

Pufferpig - a neutral and **OVERPOWERED** pig that can be tamed and ridden

- **Items**

Antipufferpig3000 - a device that is strong enough to instantly kill ANY mob including pufferpig 

Antipufferpig orb - ammo for Anitpufferpig3000 

More godlen carrot - a even more golden carrot that acts like a golden apple 

Enchantedgoldencarrot - a enchanted golden carrot that acts like a enchanted golden apple and is used to tame Pufferpig

- **Recipes**

Antipufferpig3000 - So far is only obtainable through creative or commands 

More golden carrot - A golden carrot in the middle surrounded by golden ingots 

Enchanted golden carrot - A more golden carrot surrounded by golden blocks 

Enchanted golden apple - A golden apple surrounded by golden blocks.

## 🛑 **Incompatibilities**
Nothing that I know of but try avoiding mods that has very heavy impact and/or is unstable

### 🎂 **Special Thanks**
Thanks to MCreator for making this project possible.
